_changelog: v1.0.0 (2026-10-07) first version, from docs/projects-v1.0.0.md; unlocks use core cases only
title: Nightwatch
language: Go checkers, TypeScript API and web
pitch: Multi-region uptime monitoring where checkers agree before they wake anyone, plus an AI incident copilot.

milestones.title: Monitors, one checker, a status page, SSRF protection
milestones.spec:
The smallest real version.

- An API to register monitors (URL, interval, expected status).
- One checker that runs them and stores results in Postgres.
- A public status page.
- Refuse private addresses and cloud metadata endpoints (SSRF protection).
milestones.promptPack:
Create a monorepo named nightwatch with a TypeScript API (monitors CRUD with validation, Postgres) and a Go checker that runs HTTP checks on schedule and writes results. Before every check, resolve the host and refuse private, loopback, link-local and cloud metadata addresses, including after redirects. Add a public status page. Tests: API validation, checker results, and SSRF refusal for 127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.0/8, 169.254.169.254 and a redirect to a private address.

milestones.title: Time-series storage and uptime math
milestones.spec:
Store results so that uptime questions stay fast.

- Rollups (per minute, hour, day) and retention.
- Uptime percentage over any window.
- The right indexes.
milestones.promptPack:
Add rollup tables (minute, hour, day) maintained by a job, a retention policy, and uptime and latency-percentile queries over any window. Add indexes and show query plans in docs/decisions.md. Load one million synthetic results and assert a 30-day uptime query returns under a stated time.

milestones.title: Scheduler, queue, workers, alerts without duplicates
milestones.spec:
Scale out checks and alerts.

- A scheduler puts due checks on a queue; worker checkers take them.
- Alerts fan out to email, Slack and webhooks.
- No missed checks and no duplicate alerts.
milestones.promptPack:
Split scheduling from checking: a scheduler enqueues due checks, a pool of checker workers consumes them with acknowledgements and visibility timeouts. Alerts fan out through pub/sub to email, Slack and webhook senders, each deduplicated with an idempotency key per incident and channel. Test: kill a worker mid-check and assert no missed checks and no duplicate alerts.

milestones.title: No false alarms, SLOs, monitoring the monitor
milestones.spec:
Wake people only for real problems.

- Two-stage confirmation before declaring an incident.
- SLOs and error budgets for monitored sites.
- Nightwatch monitors itself.
- An incident timeline.
milestones.promptPack:
Add two-stage confirmation (a failure must repeat within a window before an incident opens), SLOs with error budgets per monitor, an external heartbeat so Nightwatch's own scheduler is monitored, and an incident timeline. Test with a flaky-network simulation: zero false pages while real outages still page within the stated time.

milestones.title: Teams, roles, API keys, audit log
milestones.spec:
Make it safe for many customers.

- Accounts and teams with roles.
- API keys stored hashed, shown once.
- Tenant isolation on every query.
- An audit log of admin actions.
milestones.promptPack:
Add teams with role-based access (owner, admin, member), login with sessions, API keys stored as hashes and shown once, tenant isolation enforced in every query (consider row-level security), and an append-only audit log for admin actions. Tests: a member of team A can never read team B's monitors or results through any endpoint; every admin action creates an audit entry.

milestones.title: Three regions that must agree
milestones.spec:
The distributed systems heart of Nightwatch.

- Checkers in three regions.
- A site is down only when a quorum of regions agrees.
- Tell apart my checker can't reach it from the site is down.
- Leader election for the scheduler.
milestones.promptPack:
Run checkers in three regions. An incident opens only when a quorum (2 of 3) reports failure within a window. A region that cannot reach several unrelated sites marks itself suspect instead of reporting them down. Elect one scheduler leader using a lease with fencing tokens. Test: isolate one region with a simulated partition and assert it cannot trigger a page; kill the leader and assert a new one takes over without double-scheduling.

milestones.title: Multi-region deploy, capacity and cost
milestones.spec:
Run it for real, and know what it costs.

- Deploy across regions.
- Survive losing a region.
- Cost per 1,000 checks.
milestones.promptPack:
Deploy nightwatch across at least two cloud regions with a budget alarm set first, document the topology, run a region-loss drill, and produce a cost report per 1,000 checks with the assumptions written down. Keep everything inside the budget cap you set.

milestones.title: Incident copilot v1: RAG over runbooks
milestones.spec:
Start the AI half of Nightwatch.

- Ingest logs, deploy events and runbooks.
- For an incident, suggest the likely cause with cited evidence.
milestones.promptPack:
Add an incident copilot service: ingest recent logs, deploy events and markdown runbooks; index runbooks with hybrid search; for an open incident, gather evidence and ask an LLM for the likely cause, citing the exact log lines and runbook sections used. Never send secrets or personal data to the model: redact before sending. Add tests for retrieval and for redaction.

milestones.title: Evals on 50 past incidents
milestones.spec:
Measure the copilot.

- A library of 50 recorded (synthetic) incidents with known causes.
- Likely-cause accuracy and citation faithfulness, run in CI.
milestones.promptPack:
Create 50 synthetic incidents with known root causes, logs and runbooks. Build an eval that scores likely-cause accuracy and citation faithfulness (an LLM judge checked against 15 hand-labelled cases). Run it in CI and fail the build on a drop. Report baseline and improved scores after at least two iterations.

milestones.title: An agent with tools and guardrails
milestones.spec:
Let the copilot investigate.

- Tools: query metrics, fetch logs, list recent deploys.
- Read-only by default; anything else needs a human.
- Resistant to prompt injection hidden in log text.
milestones.promptPack:
Turn the copilot into an agent with read-only tools (query metrics, fetch logs, list deploys), a step and cost budget, and a human approval gate for anything that changes state. Add a red-team suite of 20 incidents whose logs contain injected instructions and assert the agent never follows them or leaks data.

milestones.title: Drafted post-mortems
milestones.spec:

- Draft a blameless post-mortem from the incident timeline.
- Draft an on-call handoff note.

Generate blameless post-mortem drafts (summary, impact, timeline, cause, what went well, action items) and on-call handoff notes from the incident timeline, with structured output validated against a schema. Rate 10 drafts yourself with a simple rubric and record the results.

milestones.title: Cost and speed through an LLM gateway
milestones.spec:
Make the AI part cheap and fast.

- Route calls through a gateway with caching and model routing.
- Report cost per incident analysis before and after.
milestones.promptPack:
Put all model calls behind a small gateway with prompt caching, response caching for repeated lookups, routing of simple steps to a cheaper model, retries with backoff and per-team budgets. Report cost per incident analysis and latency before and after, with the eval scores unchanged or better.

milestones.title: A small self-hosted model for log triage
milestones.spec:
The inference rung inside Nightwatch.

- Serve a small open model to sort log lines.
